newsitem.title: USA: LaSalle to participate in Lloyd's.
newsitem.headline: LaSalle to participate in Lloyd's.

text.p: Bermuda-based LaSalle Re Holdings Ltd said it has formed a new subsidiary, LaSalle Re Corporate Capital Ltd, to participate in the Lloyd's of London market.
LaSalle Re Corporate Capital will underwrite business through three Lloyd's syndicates, T F Hart Syndicate, D Marshall Syndicate and the R McCarthy Syndicate, the company said.

LaSalle Re Corporate Capital will participate along with other corporate members on T F Hart, writing marine insurance and reinsurance, and on D Marshall, writing professional indemnity and directors and officers' insurance and bankers blanket bond business, the company said.
It will be a co-participant with CNA Financial Corp's CNA Underwriting Agencies Ltd in the R McCarthy syndicate, writing direct and facultative property insurance.
The Lloyd's participation is part of the company's ongoing strategy to diversify its business, both in geographic terms and in lines of business written, LaSalle chief executive Victor Blake said.
"We are already represented in London through our office at the London Underwriting Centre," he said.

"We believe, however, that the Lloyd's market also offers significant opportunities to participate in quality business -- and that establishing a subsidiary as a corporate Name (backer) represents the most cost-effective means of participating in this key market," he said.

"The formation of LaSalle Re Corporate Capital as a Lloyd's corporate member offered us an alternative strategy to the full-blown purchase of a syndicate, whilst keeping us abreast of future opportunities for participation in Lloyd's," he said.
LaSalle Re, through its LaSalle Re Ltd subsidiary, writes high severity, low frequency reinsurance, primarily property catastrophe reinsurance, on a worldwide basis.
